Format your line by line review like this example:

```
  cmd/remote.go

  Line 12 (removed): Removed unused import of pkg/service package

  // Old: config, err := service.LoadConfig(dir)
  // New: rpcClient, err := client.NewRPCClient(dir)
  - (2) ✅ Good architectural decision - Now operates via daemon RPC instead of direct file access
  - (3) ✅ Proper defer cleanup pattern for RPC client
  - (4) ✅ Variable name rpcClient is clear and follows conventions

We focus our unit tests on complicated logic, and combinatorial scenarios, not on coverage or completeness for completeness sake.    139→+    59→

   162→+    82→## Configuration File
   163→+    83→
   164→+    84→SpecStory CLI supports configuration files in TOML format. Settings can be configured at two levels:
   165→+    85→
   166→+    86→1. **User-level config**: `~/.specstory/cli/config.toml` - applies to all projects
   167→+    87→2. **Project-level config**: `.specstory/cli/config.toml` - applies only to the current project
   168→+    88→
   169→+    89→Configuration is loaded with the following priority (highest to lowest):
   170→+    90→1. CLI flags
   171→+    91→2. Project-level config (`.specstory/cli/config.toml`)
   172→+    92→3. User-level config (`~/.specstory/cli/config.toml`)
   173→+    93→
   174→+    94→### Example Configuration
   175→+    95→
   176→+    96→```toml
   177→+    97→# SpecStory CLI Configuration
   178→+    98→#
   179→+    99→# Uncomment (remove the #) the line and edit any setting below to change the default behavior.
   180→+   100→# For more information, see: https://docs.specstory.com/integrations/terminal-coding-agents/usage
   181→+   101→
   182→+   102→[local_sync]
   183→+   103→# Write markdown files locally. (default: true)
   184→+   104→# enabled = false # equivalent to --only-cloud-sync
   185→+   105→
   186→+   106→# Custom output directory for markdown files.
   187→+   107→# Default: ./.specstory/history (relative to the project directory)
   188→+   108→# output_dir = "~/.specstory/history" # equivalent to --output-dir "~/.specstory/history"
   189→+   109→
   190→+   110→# Use local timezone for file name and content timestamps (default: false, UTC)
   191→+   111→# local_time_zone = true # equivalent to --local-time-zone
   192→+   112→
   193→+   113→[cloud_sync]
   194→+   114→# Sync session data to SpecStory Cloud. (default: true, when logged in to SpecStory Cloud)
   195→+   115→# enabled = false # equivalent to --no-cloud-sync
   196→+   116→
   197→+   117→[logging]
   198→+   118→# Custom output directory for debug data.
   199→+   119→# Default: ./.specstory/debug (relative to the project directory)
   200→+   120→# debug_dir = "~/.specstory/debug" # equivalent to --debug-dir "~/.specstory/debug"
   201→+   121→
   202→+   122→# Error/warn/info output to stdout (default: false)
   203→+   123→# console = true # equivalent to --console
   204→+   124→
   205→+   125→# Write logs to .specstory/debug/debug.log (default: false)
   206→+   126→# log = true # equivalent to --log
   207→+   127→
   208→+   128→# Debug-level output, requires console or log (default: false)
   209→+   129→# debug = true # equivalent to --debug
   210→+   130→
   211→+   131→# Suppress all non-error output (default: false)
   212→+   132→# silent = true # equivalent to --silence
   213→+   133→
   214→+   134→[version_check]
   215→+   135→# Check for new versions of the CLI on startup.
   216→+   136→# Default: true
   217→+   137→# enabled = false # equivalent to --no-version-check
   218→+   138→
   219→+   139→[analytics]
   220→+   140→<<<<<<< HEAD
   221→+   141→# Send anonymous usage analytics (default: true)
   222→+   142→enabled = true
   223→+   143→
   224→+   144→[telemetry]
   225→+   145→# Enable OpenTelemetry tracing and metrics (default: false, auto-enabled if endpoint is set)
   226→+   146→enabled = true
   227→+   147→# OTLP gRPC collector endpoint (e.g., "localhost:4317" or "http://localhost:4317")
   228→+   148→endpoint = "localhost:4317"
   229→+   149→# Override the default service name (default: "specstory-cli")
   230→+   150→service_name = "specstory-cli"
   231→+   151→# Exclude user prompt text from telemetry spans for privacy (default: false)
   232→+   152→no_prompts = false
   233→+   153→=======
   234→+   154→# Send anonymous product usage analytics to help improve SpecStory.
   235→+   155→# Default: true
   236→+   156→# enabled = false # equivalent to --no-usage-analytics
   237→+   157→
   238→+   158→[providers]
   239→+   159→# Agent execution commands by provider (used by specstory run)
   240→+   160→# Pass custom flags (e.g. claude_cmd = "claude --allow-dangerously-skip-permissions")
   241→+   161→# Use of these is equivalent to -c "custom command"
   242→+   162→
   243→+   163→# Claude Code command
   244→+   164→# claude_cmd = "claude"
   245→+   165→
   246→+   166→# Codex CLI command
   247→+   167→# codex_cmd = "codex"
   248→+   168→
   249→+   169→# Cursor CLI command
   250→+   170→# cursor_cmd = "cursor-agent"
   251→+   171→
   252→+   172→# Droid CLI command
   253→+   173→# droid_cmd = "droid"
   254→+   174→
   255→+   175→# Gemini CLI command
   256→+   176→# gemini_cmd = "gemini"
   257→+   177→>>>>>>> dev
   258→+   178→```
   259→+   179→
   260→+   180→### Configuration Options
   261→+   181→
   262→+   182→<<<<<<< HEAD
   263→+   183→| Section | Option | Default | Description |
   264→+   184→|---------|--------|---------|-------------|
   265→+   185→| (root) | `output_dir` | `.specstory/history` | Custom output directory for markdown files |
   266→+   186→| `[version_check]` | `enabled` | `true` | Check for newer CLI versions on startup |
   267→+   187→| `[cloud_sync]` | `enabled` | `true` | Sync sessions to SpecStory Cloud |

   300→+   220→
   301→+   221→## Development
   302→+   222→
   303→+   223→### Development Prerequisites
   304→+   224→
   305→+   225→- macOS development environment
   306→+   226→- Go 1.25.1 or later
   307→+   227→- golangci-lint, latest version
   308→+   228→- Access to one or more terminal coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Codex CLI, etc.)
   309→+   229→
   310→+   230→You'll want [Homebrew](https://brew.sh/) installed on your macOS system. Then:
   311→+   231→
   312→+   232→```zsh
   313→+   233→brew install go golangci-lint
   314→+   234→```
   315→+   235→
   316→+   236→You'll also want this test helper:
   317→+   237→
   318→+   238→```zsh
   319→+   239→go install gotest.tools/gotestsum@latest
   320→+   240→```
   321→+   241→
   322→+   242→### Building from source
   323→+   243→
   324→+   244→```zsh
   325→+   245→# Clone the repository
   326→+   246→git clone https://github.com/specstoryai/specstory-cli.git
   327→+   247→
   328→+   248→# Navigate to the project directory
   329→+   249→cd specstory-cli
   330→+   250→
   331→+   251→# Build the project
   332→+   252→go build -o specstory
   333→+   253→```
   334→+   254→
   335→+   255→You can then run the built executable from there.
   336→+   256→
   337→+   257→### Check for Outdated Dependencies
   338→+   258→
   339→+   259→```zsh
   340→+   260→go list -m -u all
   341→+   261→```
   342→+   262→
   343→+   263→### Debug Raw Mode
   344→+   264→
   345→+   265→The `--debug-raw` flag enables a debug mode that is useful for developers working on the SpecStory CLI. It outputs the raw data from AI coding agents in a pretty-printed format. This hidden flag works with all operation modes and supports all providers (Claude Code, Cursor CLI, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Droid CLI).
   346→+   266→
   347→+   267→When enabled, it creates a debug directory structure under `.specstory/debug/` with individual pretty-printed JSON files for each record in the session as well as a JSON version of the SessionData returned from the provider for that session.
   348→+   268→
   349→+   269→This mode is useful for:
   350→+   270→- Understanding the raw data structure from different AI coding agents
   351→+   271→- Analyzing conversation flow and metadata
   352→+   272→- Debugging parsing issues
   353→+   273→- Troubleshooting agent-specific data formats
   354→+   274→
   355→+   275→Run mode with debug output:
   356→+   276→
   357→+   277→```zsh
   358→+   278→./specstory run --debug-raw
   359→+   279→```
   360→+   280→
   361→+   281→Sync mode with debug output:
   362→+   282→
   363→+   283→```zsh
   364→+   284→./specstory sync --debug-raw
   365→+   285→```
   366→+   286→
   367→+   287→Sync specific session with debug output:
   368→+   288→
   369→+   289→```zsh
   370→+   290→./specstory sync -s <session-id> --debug-raw
   371→+   291→```
   372→+   292→
   373→+   293→**Output Structure:**
   374→+   294→
   375→+   295→```
   376→+   296→.specstory/debug/
   377→+   297→└── <session-uuid>/
   378→+   298→    ├── 1.json      # Claude Code: sequential numbering
   379→+   299→    ├── 2.json      # Cursor CLI: based on rowid
   380→+   300→    ├── 3.json
   381→+   301→    └── ...
   382→+   302→    └── session-data.json # JSON version of the SessionData returned from the provider for this session
   383→+   303→```
   384→+   304→
   385→+   305→Each JSON file is pretty-printed with 2-space indentation. For Claude Code, files are numbered sequentially based on their position in the JSONL file. For Cursor CLI, files are numbered based on the SQLite rowid.
   386→+   306→
   387→+   307→**Example:**
   388→+   308→
   389→+   309→If processing a session with ID `30cc3569-a9d4-429e-981a-ab73e3ddee5f`, the debug files will be created in: `.specstory/debug/30cc3569-a9d4-429e-981a-ab73e3ddee5f/`
   390→+   310→
   391→+   311→## Testing
   392→+   312→
   393→+   313→To run all tests with easy to read output:
   394→+   314→
   395→+   315→```zsh
   396→+   316→gotestsum ./...
   397→+   317→```
   398→+   318→
   399→+   319→Run tests with verbose output:
   400→+   320→
   401→+   321→```zsh
   402→+   322→go test -v ./...
   403→+   323→```
   404→+   324→
   405→+   325→Test specific packages:
   406→+   326→
   407→+   327→```zsh
   408→+   328→go test -v ./pkg/cli 
   409→+   329→```
   410→+   330→
   411→+   331→Run specific tests (e.g., filename generation tests)
   412→+   332→
   413→+   333→```zsh
   414→+   334→go test  -v ./pkg/cli -run TestGenerateFilenameFromUserMessage
   415→+   335→```
   416→+   336→
   417→+   337→Testing specific features
   418→+   338→
   419→+   339→```zsh
   420→+   340→# Test the new filename generation logic
   421→+   341→go test -v ./pkg/cli -run "TestExtractWordsFromMessage|TestGenerateFilenameFromWords|TestGenerateFilenameFromUserMessage"
   422→+   342→```
   423→+   343→
   424→+   344→## Linting
   425→+   345→
   426→+   346→This project uses [golangci-lint](https://golangci-lint.run/) for code quality checks. The configuration enables all default linters plus `gofmt` and `goimports` for consistent formatting.
   427→+   347→
   428→+   348→### Running the linter
   429→+   349→
   430→+   350→Check all Go files in the project:
   431→+   351→
   432→+   352→```zsh
   433→+   353→golangci-lint run
   434→+   354→```
   435→+   355→
   436→+   356→Automatically fix issues where possible:
   437→+   357→
   438→+   358→```zsh
   439→+   359→golangci-lint run --fix
   440→+   360→```
   441→+   361→
   442→+   362→Check a specific package:
   443→+   363→
   444→+   364→```zsh
   445→+   365→golangci-lint run ./pkg/analytics/...
   446→+   366→```
   447→+   367→
   448→+   368→**Note:** Always run the linter on directories or packages, not individual files. Running on single files can cause false positives where symbols from other files in the same package cannot be resolved.
   449→+   369→
   450→+   370→Format code:
   451→+   371→
   452→+   372→```zsh
   453→+   373→gofmt -w .
   454→+   374→```
   455→+   375→
   456→+   376→### Linter Configuration
   457→+   377→
   458→+   378→The linter configuration is in `.golangci.yml`. Key linters include:
   459→+   379→- **errcheck**: Ensures error return values are checked
   460→+   380→- **gofmt**: Enforces standard Go formatting
   461→+   381→- **goimports**: Manages import statements
   462→+   382→- **staticcheck**: Comprehensive bug detection
   463→+   383→- **govet**: Reports suspicious constructs
   464→+   384→
   465→+   385→To see all enabled linters:
   466→+   386→
   467→+   387→```zsh
   468→+   388→golangci-lint linters
   469→+   389→```
   470→+   390→
   471→+   391→## Analytics
   472→+   392→
   473→+   393→SpecStory CLI collects anonymous usage analytics to PostHog to help improve the product. The following events are tracked:
   474→+   394→
   475→+   395→- Extension activation (in interacive mode) - ext_activated
   476→+   396→- Successful markdown sync operations - ext_sync_markdown_success
   477→+   397→- Failed markdown sync operations - ext_sync_markdown_error
   478→+   398→- First-time autosave of new sessions - ext_autosave_success
   479→+   399→- Failed first-time autosave of new sessions - ext_autosave_error
   480→+   400→
   481→+   401→All analytics are processed through PostHog with GeoIP enabled for general location data.
   482→+   402→
   483→+   403→### Disabling Analytics
   484→+   404→
   485→+   405→To opt out of analytics tracking, use the `--no-usage-analytics` flag:
   486→+   406→
   487→+   407→```bash
   488→+   408→specstory --no-usage-analytics [other options]
   489→+   409→```
   490→+   410→
   491→+   411→**Note**: Error tracking events include a 500ms delay before the program exits to ensure events are sent successfully. This is necessary because PostHog sends events asynchronously.
   492→+   412→
   493→+   413→### Development Analytics
   494→+   414→
   495→+   415→Analytics are disabled in development builds by default. To enable analytics during local development, build with the PostHog API key:
   496→+   416→
   497→+   417→```zsh
   498→+   418→export POSTHOG_API_KEY="your-posthog-api-key"
   499→+   419→go build -ldflags "-X github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/specstory-cli/pkg/analytics.apiKey=$POSTHOG_API_KEY" -o specstory ./
   500→+   420→```
```

 30704→+## Analytics
 30705→+
 30706→+SpecStory CLI collects anonymous usage analytics to PostHog to help improve the product. The following events are tracked:
 30707→+
 30708→+- Extension activation (in interacive mode) - ext_activated
 30709→+- Successful markdown sync operations - ext_sync_markdown_success
 30710→+- Failed markdown sync operations - ext_sync_markdown_error
 30711→+- First-time autosave of new sessions - ext_autosave_success
 30712→+- Failed first-time autosave of new sessions - ext_autosave_error
 30713→+
 30714→+All analytics are processed through PostHog with GeoIP enabled for general location data.
 30715→+
 30716→+### Disabling Analytics
 30717→+
 30718→+To opt out of analytics tracking, use the `--no-usage-analytics` flag:
 30719→+
 30720→+```zsh
 30721→+specstory --no-usage-analytics [other options]
 30722→+```
 30723→+
 30724→+**Note**: Error tracking events include a 500ms delay before the program exits to ensure events are sent successfully. This is necessary because PostHog sends events asynchronously.
 30725→+
 30726→+### Development Analytics
 30727→+
 30728→+Analytics are disabled in development builds by default. To enable analytics during local development, build with the PostHog API key:
 30729→+
 30730→+```zsh
 30731→+export POSTHOG_API_KEY="your-posthog-api-key"
 30732→+go build -ldflags "-X github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/specstory-cli/pkg/analytics.apiKey=$POSTHOG_API_KEY" -o specstory ./
 30733→+```
 30734→+
 30735→+## Open Telemetry
 30736→+
 30737→+SpecStory CLI supports [OpenTelemetry](https://opentelemetry.io/) Protocol (OTLP) tracing and metrics for observability. When enabled, it emits spans for session processing with detailed attributes about exchanges, messages, tool usage, and token consumption.
 30738→+
 30739→+### Enabling Telemetry
 30740→+
 30741→+Optional OpenTelemetry data can be enabled in three ways:
 30742→+
 30743→+1. **Standard OTEL Environment variables** (highest priority for telemetry settings):
 30744→+   
 30745→+   ```zsh
 30746→+   export OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT="localhost:4317"
 30747→+   export OTEL_SERVICE_NAME="specstory-cli"
 30748→+   export OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES="user_id_hash=user_name,env=dev"
 30749→+   
 30750→+   specstory run
 30751→+   # or
 30752→+   specstory sync
 30753→+   # or
 30754→+   specstory watch
 30755→+   ```
 30756→+
 30757→+2. **CLI flags**:
 30758→+   
 30759→+   ```zsh
 30760→+   specstory sync --telemetry-endpoint localhost:4317 --telemetry-service-name my-service --no-telemetry-prompts
 30761→+   ```
 30762→+
 30763→+3. **Configuration files** (`./.specstory/cli/config.toml` or `~/.specstory/cli/config.toml`):
 30764→+
 30765→+   ```toml
 30766→+   [telemetry]
 30767→+   # OTLP gRPC collector endpoint (e.g., "localhost:4317" or "http://localhost:4317")
 30768→+   endpoint = "localhost:4317"
 30769→+
 30770→+   # Override the default service name (default: "specstory-cli")
 30771→+   service_name = "my-service-name"
 30772→+
 30773→+   # Exclude user prompt text from telemetry spans for privacy (default: true)
 30774→+   prompts = false
 30775→+   ```
 30776→+
 30777→+### Telemetry Configuration Options
 30778→+
 30779→+| Option       | CLI Flag                   | Environment Variable          | Config Key               | Default         | Description                            |
 30780→+|--------------|----------------------------|-------------------------------|--------------------------|-----------------|----------------------------------------|
 30781→+| Disable      | default                    | `OTEL_SDK_DISABLED`           |                          |                 | Disable telemetry                      |
 30782→+| Endpoint     | `--telemetry-endpoint`     | `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT` | `telemetry.endpoint`     | `""`            | OTLP gRPC collector endpoint           |
 30783→+| Service Name | `--telemetry-service-name` | `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME`           | `telemetry.service_name` | `specstory-cli` | Service name for spans/metrics         |
 30784→+| No Prompts   | `--no-telemetry-prompts`   | -                             | `telemetry.prompts`      | `true`          | Include/exclude prompt text from spans |
 30785→+
 30786→+**Note**: Telemetry is enabled when an endpoint is configured unless the standard `OTEL_SDK_DISABLED` ENV var is set to `true` or `1`.
 30787→+
 30788→+### Excluding Prompt Text
 30789→+
 30790→+You can exclude user prompt text from telemetry spans. When excluded, the `specstory.exchange.prompt_text` attribute will be empty.
 30791→+
 30792→+Via CLI flag:
 30793→+
 30794→+```zsh
 30795→+specstory sync --no-telemetry-prompts
 30796→+```
 30797→+
 30798→+Via configuration files:
 30799→+
 30800→+```toml
 30801→+[telemetry]
 30802→+# Exclude user prompt text from telemetry spans for privacy (default: true)
 30803→+prompts = false
 30804→+```
 30805→+
 30806→+### Disabling Telemetry
 30807→+
 30808→+Telemetry is disabled unless you configure an OLTP endpoint. If you do want to disable telemetry while keeping an endpoint configured, you can use `OTEL_SDK_DISABLED`, which is a standard OTel convention:
 30809→+
 30810→+```zsh
 30811→+export OTEL_SDK_DISABLED="true"
 30812→+```
 30813→+
 30814→+### Telemetry Data
 30815→+
 30816→+#### Session Span Attributes
 30817→+
 30818→+Each session processing span includes the following attributes:
 30819→+
 30820→+| Attribute                                   | Description                                    |
 30821→+|---------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------|
 30822→+| `specstory.agent`                           | The agent provider name (e.g., "claude-code")  |
 30823→+| `specstory.session.id`                      | Unique session identifier                      |
 30824→+| `specstory.session.exchange_count`          | Number of exchanges in the session             |
 30825→+| `specstory.session.message_count`           | Total messages across all exchanges            |
 30826→+| `specstory.session.tool_count`              | Total tool invocations                         |
 30827→+| `specstory.session.tool_type_count`         | Number of unique tool types used               |
 30828→+| `specstory.project.path`                    | Workspace root path                            |
 30829→+| `specstory.session.tokens.input`            | Total input tokens (all providers)             |
 30830→+| `specstory.session.tokens.output`           | Total output tokens (all providers)            |
 30831→+| `specstory.session.tokens.cache_creation`   | Cache creation tokens (Claude Code, Droid CLI) |
 30832→+| `specstory.session.tokens.cache_read`       | Cache read tokens (Claude Code, Droid CLI)     |
 30833→+| `specstory.session.tokens.cached_input`     | Cached input tokens (Codex CLI)                |
 30834→+| `specstory.session.tokens.reasoning_output` | Reasoning output tokens (Codex CLI)            |
 30835→+| `specstory.session.tokens.cached`           | Cached tokens (Gemini CLI)                     |
 30836→+| `specstory.session.tokens.thought`          | Thought/reasoning tokens (Gemini CLI)          |
 30837→+| `specstory.session.tokens.tool`             | Tool-related tokens (Gemini CLI)               |
 30838→+| `specstory.session.tokens.thinking`         | Thinking tokens (Droid CLI)                    |
 30839→+
 30840→+#### Exchange Span Attributes
 30841→+
 30842→+Each exchange is recorded as a child span with these attributes:
 30843→+
 30844→+| Attribute                                    | Description                                    |
 30845→+|----------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------|
 30846→+| `specstory.exchange.id`                      | Exchange identifier                            |
 30847→+| `specstory.exchange.index`                   | Exchange index in session                      |
 30848→+| `specstory.exchange.model`                   | Model used for this exchange                   |
 30849→+| `specstory.exchange.prompt_text`             | User prompt text (unless `no_prompts` is set)  |
 30850→+| `specstory.exchange.start_time`              | Exchange start timestamp                       |
 30851→+| `specstory.exchange.end_time`                | Exchange end timestamp                         |
 30852→+| `specstory.exchange.message_count`           | Messages in this exchange                      |
 30853→+| `specstory.exchange.tools_used`              | Comma-separated tool names                     |
 30854→+| `specstory.exchange.tool_types`              | Comma-separated tool types                     |
 30855→+| `specstory.exchange.tool_count`              | Number of tool invocations                     |
 30856→+| `specstory.exchange.tokens.input`            | Input tokens for this exchange                 |
 30857→+| `specstory.exchange.tokens.output`           | Output tokens for this exchange                |
 30858→+| `specstory.exchange.tokens.cache_creation`   | Cache creation tokens (Claude Code, Droid CLI) |
 30859→+| `specstory.exchange.tokens.cache_read`       | Cache read tokens (Claude Code, Droid CLI)     |
 30860→+| `specstory.exchange.tokens.cached_input`     | Cached input tokens (Codex CLI)                |
 30861→+| `specstory.exchange.tokens.reasoning_output` | Reasoning output tokens (Codex CLI)            |
 30862→+| `specstory.exchange.tokens.cached`           | Cached tokens (Gemini CLI)                     |
 30863→+| `specstory.exchange.tokens.thought`          | Thought/reasoning tokens (Gemini CLI)          |
 30864→+| `specstory.exchange.tokens.tool`             | Tool-related tokens (Gemini CLI)               |
 30865→+| `specstory.exchange.tokens.thinking`         | Thinking tokens (Droid CLI)                    |

 32480→+// GetIntFromMap safely extracts an int from a map[string]interface{}.
 32481→+// JSON numbers are unmarshaled as float64, so we handle that case.
 32482→+func GetIntFromMap(m map[string]interface{}, key string) int {
 32483→+	if m == nil {
 32484→+		return 0
 32485→+	}
 32486→+	if val, ok := m[key]; ok {
 32487→+		switch v := val.(type) {
 32488→+		case float64:
 32489→+			return int(v)
 32490→+		case int64:
 32491→+			return int(v)
 32492→+		case int:
 32493→+			return v
 32494→+		}
 32495→+	}
 32496→+	return 0
 32497→+}

 32732→+// ProcessExchangeSpans creates child spans for all exchanges in a session.
 32733→+// This is a helper that creates spans, sets attributes, and ends them immediately
 32734→+// since exchange processing is retrospective (data already exists).
 32735→+// When noPrompts is true, the prompt_text attribute will be empty for privacy.
 32736→+func ProcessExchangeSpans(ctx context.Context, stats SessionStats, exchanges []schema.Exchange, noPrompts bool) {
 32737→+	telemetryLogger().Debug("Creating exchange spans",
 32738→+		"sessionId", stats.SessionID,
 32739→+		"exchangeCount", len(exchanges),
 32740→+		"noPrompts", noPrompts,
 32741→+	)
 32742→+	for i, exchange := range exchanges {
 32743→+		_, exchangeSpan := startExchangeSpan(ctx, stats.SessionID, exchange.ExchangeID, i)
 32744→+		exchangeStats := computeExchangeStats(exchange, i)
 32745→+		if noPrompts {
 32746→+			exchangeStats.PromptText = ""
 32747→+		}
 32748→+		setExchangeSpanAttributes(exchangeSpan, exchangeStats)
 32749→+		exchangeSpan.End()
 32750→+	}
 32751→+}

 32776→+
 32777→+// --- Exchange Helpers ---
 32778→+
 32779→+// extractToolInfo extracts tool usage information from an exchange.
 32780→+// Returns: comma-separated unique tool names, comma-separated unique tool types, and total tool count.
 32781→+func extractToolInfo(exchange schema.Exchange) (toolNames string, toolTypes string, toolCount int) {
 32782→+	nameSet := make(map[string]bool)
 32783→+	typeSet := make(map[string]bool)
 32784→+
 32785→+	for _, msg := range exchange.Messages {
 32786→+		if msg.Tool != nil && msg.Tool.Name != "" {
 32787→+			toolCount++
 32788→+			nameSet[msg.Tool.Name] = true
 32789→+			if msg.Tool.Type != "" {
 32790→+				typeSet[msg.Tool.Type] = true
 32791→+			}
 32792→+		}
 32793→+	}
 32794→+
 32795→+	// Build unique tool names list (sorted for deterministic output)
 32796→+	var names []string
 32797→+	for n := range nameSet {
 32798→+		names = append(names, n)
 32799→+	}
 32800→+	sort.Strings(names)
 32801→+
 32802→+	// Build unique tool types list (sorted for deterministic output)
 32803→+	var types []string
 32804→+	for t := range typeSet {
 32805→+		types = append(types, t)
 32806→+	}
 32807→+	sort.Strings(types)
 32808→+
 32809→+	return strings.Join(names, ","), strings.Join(types, ","), toolCount
 32810→+}
 32811→+
 32812→+// extractUserPromptText finds the first user message in an exchange and returns its text content.
 32813→+func extractUserPromptText(exchange schema.Exchange) string {
 32814→+	for _, msg := range exchange.Messages {
 32815→+		if msg.Role == schema.RoleUser {
 32816→+			// Concatenate all text content parts
 32817→+			var text string
 32818→+			for _, part := range msg.Content {
 32819→+				if part.Type == schema.ContentTypeText {
 32820→+					if text != "" {
 32821→+						text += "\n"
 32822→+					}
 32823→+					text += part.Text
 32824→+				}
 32825→+			}
 32826→+			return text
 32827→+		}
 32828→+	}
 32829→+	return ""
 32830→+}
 32831→+
 32832→+// extractModel finds the model used in an exchange by looking at agent messages.
 32833→+// Returns the model from the first agent message that has one set.
 32834→+func extractModel(exchange schema.Exchange) string {
 32835→+	for _, msg := range exchange.Messages {
 32836→+		if msg.Role == schema.RoleAgent && msg.Model != "" {
 32837→+			return msg.Model
 32838→+		}
 32839→+	}
 32840→+	return ""
 32841→+}
 32842→+
 32843→+// --- Counting Helpers ---
 32844→+
 32845→+// countSessionMessages counts total messages across all exchanges.
 32846→+func countSessionMessages(exchanges []schema.Exchange) int {
 32847→+	count := 0
 32848→+	for _, exchange := range exchanges {
 32849→+		count += len(exchange.Messages)
 32850→+	}
 32851→+	return count
 32852→+}
 32853→+
 32854→+// countSessionTools counts total tools and unique tool types across all exchanges.
 32855→+// Returns: total tool count, unique tool type count.
 32856→+func countSessionTools(exchanges []schema.Exchange) (toolCount int, toolTypeCount int) {
 32857→+	typeSet := make(map[string]bool)
 32858→+
 32859→+	for _, exchange := range exchanges {
 32860→+		for _, msg := range exchange.Messages {
 32861→+			if msg.Tool != nil && msg.Tool.Name != "" {
 32862→+				toolCount++
 32863→+				if msg.Tool.Type != "" {
 32864→+					typeSet[msg.Tool.Type] = true
 32865→+				}
 32866→+			}
 32867→+		}
 32868→+	}
 32869→+
 32870→+	return toolCount, len(typeSet)
 32871→+}
 32872→+
 32873→+// countExchangeTokens aggregates token usage for a single exchange.
 32874→+// Handles Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and Droid CLI specific token fields.
 32875→+func countExchangeTokens(exchange schema.Exchange) TokenUsage {
 32876→+	var usage TokenUsage
 32877→+	for _, msg := range exchange.Messages {
 32878→+		if msg.Usage != nil {
 32879→+			// Common fields (all providers)
 32880→+			usage.InputTokens += msg.Usage.InputTokens
 32881→+			usage.OutputTokens += msg.Usage.OutputTokens
 32882→+			// Claude Code specific (also used by Droid CLI)
 32883→+			usage.CacheCreationInputTokens += msg.Usage.CacheCreationInputTokens
 32884→+			usage.CacheReadInputTokens += msg.Usage.CacheReadInputTokens
 32885→+			// Codex CLI specific
 32886→+			usage.CachedInputTokens += msg.Usage.CachedInputTokens
 32887→+			usage.ReasoningOutputTokens += msg.Usage.ReasoningOutputTokens
 32888→+			// Gemini CLI specific
 32889→+			usage.CachedTokens += msg.Usage.CachedTokens
 32890→+			usage.ThoughtTokens += msg.Usage.ThoughtTokens
 32891→+			usage.ToolTokens += msg.Usage.ToolTokens
 32892→+			// Droid CLI specific
 32893→+			usage.ThinkingTokens += msg.Usage.ThinkingTokens
 32894→+		}
 32895→+	}
 32896→+	return usage
 32897→+}
 32898→+
 32899→+// countSessionTokens aggregates token usage across all exchanges in a session.
 32900→+// Handles Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and Droid CLI specific token fields.
 32901→+func countSessionTokens(exchanges []schema.Exchange) TokenUsage {
 32902→+	var total TokenUsage
 32903→+	for _, exchange := range exchanges {
 32904→+		exchangeUsage := countExchangeTokens(exchange)
 32905→+		// Common fields (all providers)
 32906→+		total.InputTokens += exchangeUsage.InputTokens
 32907→+		total.OutputTokens += exchangeUsage.OutputTokens
 32908→+		// Claude Code specific (also used by Droid CLI)
 32909→+		total.CacheCreationInputTokens += exchangeUsage.CacheCreationInputTokens
 32910→+		total.CacheReadInputTokens += exchangeUsage.CacheReadInputTokens
 32911→+		// Codex CLI specific
 32912→+		total.CachedInputTokens += exchangeUsage.CachedInputTokens
 32913→+		total.ReasoningOutputTokens += exchangeUsage.ReasoningOutputTokens
 32914→+		// Gemini CLI specific
 32915→+		total.CachedTokens += exchangeUsage.CachedTokens
 32916→+		total.ThoughtTokens += exchangeUsage.ThoughtTokens
 32917→+		total.ToolTokens += exchangeUsage.ToolTokens
 32918→+		// Droid CLI specific
 32919→+		total.ThinkingTokens += exchangeUsage.ThinkingTokens
 32920→+	}
 32921→+	return total

 33041→+	for _, tt := range tests {

 33211→+func TestCountSessionTools(t *testing.T) {
 33212→+	tests := []struct {
 33213→+		name              string
 33214→+		exchanges         []schema.Exchange
 33215→+		wantToolCount     int
 33216→+		wantToolTypeCount int
 33217→+	}{
 33218→+		{
 33219→+			name:              "empty exchanges",
 33220→+			exchanges:         []schema.Exchange{},
 33221→+			wantToolCount:     0,
 33222→+			wantToolTypeCount: 0,
 33223→+		},
 33224→+		{
 33225→+			name: "no tools",
 33226→+			exchanges: []schema.Exchange{
 33227→+				{Messages: []schema.Message{{Role: schema.RoleUser}, {Role: schema.RoleAgent}}},
 33228→+			},
 33229→+			wantToolCount:     0,
 33230→+			wantToolTypeCount: 0,
 33231→+		},
 33232→+		{
 33233→+			name: "single tool",
 33234→+			exchanges: []schema.Exchange{
 33235→+				{Messages: []schema.Message{
 33236→+					{Role: schema.RoleAgent, Tool: &schema.ToolInfo{Name: "Read", Type: "read"}},
 33237→+				}},
 33238→+			},
 33239→+			wantToolCount:     1,
 33240→+			wantToolTypeCount: 1,
 33241→+		},
 33242→+		{
 33243→+			name: "tools across multiple exchanges",
 33244→+			exchanges: []schema.Exchange{
 33245→+				{Messages: []schema.Message{
 33246→+					{Role: schema.RoleAgent, Tool: &schema.ToolInfo{Name: "Read", Type: "read"}},
 33247→+				}},
 33248→+				{Messages: []schema.Message{
 33249→+					{Role: schema.RoleAgent, Tool: &schema.ToolInfo{Name: "Write", Type: "write"}},
 33250→+					{Role: schema.RoleAgent, Tool: &schema.ToolInfo{Name: "Bash", Type: "shell"}},
 33251→+				}},
 33252→+			},
 33253→+			wantToolCount:     3,
 33254→+			wantToolTypeCount: 3,
 33255→+		},
 33256→+		{
 33257→+			name: "duplicate tool types counted once",
 33258→+			exchanges: []schema.Exchange{
 33259→+				{Messages: []schema.Message{
 33260→+					{Role: schema.RoleAgent, Tool: &schema.ToolInfo{Name: "Read", Type: "read"}},
 33261→+					{Role: schema.RoleAgent, Tool: &schema.ToolInfo{Name: "Glob", Type: "read"}},
 33262→+				}},
 33263→+			},
 33264→+			wantToolCount:     2,
 33265→+			wantToolTypeCount: 1, // both are "read" type
 33266→+		},
 33267→+	}
 33268→+
 33269→+	for _, tt := range tests {
 33270→+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
 33271→+			gotCount, gotTypeCount := countSessionTools(tt.exchanges)
 33272→+			if gotCount != tt.wantToolCount {
 33273→+				t.Errorf("countSessionTools() toolCount = %d, want %d", gotCount, tt.wantToolCount)
 33274→+			}
 33275→+			if gotTypeCount != tt.wantToolTypeCount {
 33276→+				t.Errorf("countSessionTools() toolTypeCount = %d, want %d", gotTypeCount, tt.wantToolTypeCount)
 33277→+			}
 33278→+		})
 33279→+	}
 33280→+}

 33770→+// Package telemetry provides OpenTelemetry trace and metric initialization for the SpecStory CLI.
 33771→+// It follows the same idempotent-init pattern as pkg/analytics: first call to Init wins,
 33772→+// disabled path uses the OTel no-op provider (zero overhead, no nil checks needed).
 33773→+package telemetry
 33774→+
 33775→+import (
 33776→+	"context"
 33777→+	"crypto/sha256"
 33778→+	"fmt"
 33779→+	"log/slog"

 33798→+func telemetryLogger() *slog.Logger {
 33799→+	return slog.Default().With("component", "telemetry")
 33800→+}
 33801→+
 33802→+const (
 33803→+	// defaultEndpoint is the OTLP gRPC collector address used when
 33804→+	// OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT is set but Options.Endpoint is empty.
 33805→+	defaultEndpoint = "localhost:4317"
 33806→+
 33807→+	// metricExportInterval is how often metrics are exported to the collector.
 33808→+	metricExportInterval = 10 * time.Second
 33809→+)
 33810→+
 33811→+// Options configures telemetry initialisation.
 33812→+type Options struct {
 33813→+	ServiceName string // OTel service.name resource attribute (default "specstory-cli")
 33814→+	Endpoint    string // OTLP gRPC collector address (default "localhost:4317")
 33815→+	Enabled     bool   // When false, Init is a no-op and the global no-op provider is used
 33816→+}
 33817→+
 33818→+var (
 33819→+	initOnce       sync.Once
 33820→+	traceProvider  *sdktrace.TracerProvider
 33821→+	meterProvider  *sdkmetric.MeterProvider
 33822→+	meter          metric.Meter
 33823→+	metricsEnabled bool
 33824→+
 33825→+	// Metric instruments
 33826→+	sessionsProcessed  metric.Int64Counter
 33827→+	exchangesProcessed metric.Int64Counter
 33828→+	messagesProcessed  metric.Int64Counter
 33829→+	toolsUsed          metric.Int64Counter
 33830→+	processingDuration metric.Float64Histogram
 33831→+
 33832→+	// Token usage metrics (common)
 33833→+	inputTokensTotal  metric.Int64Counter
 33834→+	outputTokensTotal metric.Int64Counter
 33835→+
 33836→+	// Token usage metrics (Claude Code specific)
 33837→+	cacheCreationTokens metric.Int64Counter
 33838→+	cacheReadTokens     metric.Int64Counter
 33839→+
 33840→+	// Token usage metrics (Codex CLI specific)
 33841→+	cachedInputTokens     metric.Int64Counter
 33842→+	reasoningOutputTokens metric.Int64Counter
 33843→+
 33844→+	// Token usage metrics (Gemini CLI specific)
 33845→+	cachedTokens  metric.Int64Counter
 33846→+	thoughtTokens metric.Int64Counter
 33847→+	toolTokens    metric.Int64Counter
 33848→+
 33849→+	// Token usage metrics (Droid CLI specific)
 33850→+	thinkingTokens metric.Int64Counter
 33851→+
 33852→+	// Common attributes parsed from OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES to include on all metrics
 33853→+	commonMetricAttrs []attribute.KeyValue

 33855→+
 33856→+// parseResourceAttributes parses OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES env var into attribute.KeyValue slice.
 33857→+// Format: "key1=value1,key2=value2"
 33858→+func parseResourceAttributes() []attribute.KeyValue {
 33859→+	envVal := os.Getenv("OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES")
 33860→+	if envVal == "" {
 33861→+		return nil
 33862→+	}
 33863→+
 33864→+	var attrs []attribute.KeyValue
 33865→+	pairs := strings.Split(envVal, ",")
 33866→+	for _, pair := range pairs {
 33867→+		pair = strings.TrimSpace(pair)
 33868→+		if pair == "" {
 33869→+			continue
 33870→+		}
 33871→+		kv := strings.SplitN(pair, "=", 2)
 33872→+		if len(kv) == 2 {
 33873→+			key := strings.TrimSpace(kv[0])
 33874→+			value := strings.TrimSpace(kv[1])
 33875→+			if key != "" {
 33876→+				attrs = append(attrs, attribute.String(key, value))
 33877→+			}
 33878→+		}
 33879→+	}
 33880→+	return attrs
 33881→+}
 33882→+
 33883→+// parseEndpoint normalises an OTLP endpoint string into a bare host:port suitable
 33884→+// for otlptracegrpc.WithEndpoint and a flag indicating whether TLS should be disabled.
 33885→+//
 33886→+// Accepted formats:
 33887→+//
 33888→+//	"localhost:4317"              → host="localhost:4317",  insecure=true
 33889→+//	"http://localhost:4317"       → host="localhost:4317",  insecure=true
 33890→+//	"https://collector.example:4317" → host="collector.example:4317", insecure=false
 33891→+//	""                            → host=defaultEndpoint,  insecure=true
 33892→+func parseEndpoint(raw string) (host string, insecure bool) {
 33893→+	if raw == "" {
 33894→+		return defaultEndpoint, true
 33895→+	}
 33896→+
 33897→+	u, err := url.Parse(raw)
 33898→+	if err != nil || u.Host == "" {
 33899→+		// Not a URL — treat the whole string as host:port (bare address).
 33900→+		return raw, true
 33901→+	}
 33902→+
 33903→+	// Parsed successfully as a URL with a scheme.
 33904→+	host = u.Host
 33905→+	insecure = u.Scheme != "https"
 33906→+	return host, insecure
 33907→+}
 33908→+
 33909→+// Init configures the OTel tracing and metrics subsystem. Thread-safe and idempotent — only the
 33910→+// first call takes effect. When Enabled is false the global no-op provider remains
 33911→+// active, so callers can emit spans/events and record metrics safely with zero overhead.
 33912→+func Init(ctx context.Context, opts Options) error {
 33913→+	var initErr error
 33914→+	initOnce.Do(func() {
 33915→+		if !opts.Enabled {
 33916→+			telemetryLogger().Info("Telemetry disabled, using no-op provider")
 33917→+			return
 33918→+		}
 33919→+
 33920→+		// Route OTel SDK errors (export failures, connection issues) through slog
 33921→+		// so they appear in debug logs alongside our own telemetry messages.
 33922→+		otel.SetErrorHandler(otel.ErrorHandlerFunc(func(err error) {
 33923→+			telemetryLogger().Warn("OTel SDK error", "error", err)
 33924→+		}))
 33925→+
 33926→+		serviceName := opts.ServiceName
 33927→+		if serviceName == "" {
 33928→+			serviceName = "specstory-cli"
 33929→+		}
 33930→+
 33931→+		// Parse the endpoint to extract a bare host:port for WithEndpoint and
 33932→+		// determine TLS mode from the scheme. OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT is
 33933→+		// conventionally a full URL (e.g. "http://localhost:4317"), but
 33934→+		// WithEndpoint expects just "host:port".
 33935→+		host, insecure := parseEndpoint(opts.Endpoint)
 33936→+
 33937→+		// Create shared resource for both traces and metrics.
 33938→+		// Use resource.New() with detectors to pick up OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES env var.
 33939→+		res, err := resource.New(ctx,
 33940→+			resource.WithFromEnv(),      // OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES and OTEL_SERVICE_NAME
 33941→+			resource.WithTelemetrySDK(), // telemetry.sdk.* attributes
 33942→+			resource.WithHost(),         // host.* attributes
 33943→+			resource.WithAttributes(attribute.String("service.name", serviceName)), // explicit service name (can override env)
 33944→+		)
 33945→+		if err != nil {
 33946→+			initErr = fmt.Errorf("create OTel resource: %w", err)
 33947→+			return
 33948→+		}
 33949→+
 33950→+		// Log the resource attributes for debugging
 33951→+		telemetryLogger().Debug("Resource attributes created",
 33952→+			"attributes", res.Attributes(),
 33953→+			"OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES", os.Getenv("OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES"),
 33954→+		)
 33955→+
 33956→+		// Initialize tracing
 33957→+		if err := initTracing(ctx, host, insecure, res); err != nil {
 33958→+			initErr = err
 33959→+			return
 33960→+		}
 33961→+
 33962→+		// Initialize metrics
 33963→+		if err := initMetrics(ctx, host, insecure, res); err != nil {
 33964→+			// Roll back tracing initialization to avoid half-initialized state
 33965→+			telemetryLogger().Warn("Metrics init failed, rolling back tracing", "error", err)
 33966→+			if traceProvider != nil {
 33967→+				if shutdownErr := traceProvider.Shutdown(ctx); shutdownErr != nil {
 33968→+					telemetryLogger().Warn("Failed to shutdown trace provider during rollback", "error", shutdownErr)
 33969→+				}
 33970→+				traceProvider = nil
 33971→+				// Use no-op provider instead of nil per OTel documentation
 33972→+				otel.SetTracerProvider(noop.NewTracerProvider())
 33973→+			}
 33974→+			initErr = err
 33975→+			return
 33976→+		}
 33977→+
 33978→+		metricsEnabled = true
 33979→+
 33980→+		// Parse OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES and store as common metric attributes.
 33981→+		// This ensures resource attributes appear as metric tags in backends like Datadog
 33982→+		// that may not automatically promote resource-level attributes to metric tags.
 33983→+		commonMetricAttrs = parseResourceAttributes()
 33984→+		if len(commonMetricAttrs) > 0 {
 33985→+			telemetryLogger().Debug("Parsed OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES for metrics",
 33986→+				"count", len(commonMetricAttrs),
 33987→+				"attributes", commonMetricAttrs,
 33988→+			)
 33989→+		}
 33990→+
 33991→+		telemetryLogger().Info("Telemetry initialised",
 33992→+			"endpoint", host,
 33993→+			"insecure", insecure,
 33994→+			"serviceName", serviceName,
 33995→+		)
 33996→+	})
 33997→+
 33998→+	return initErr
 33999→+}
 34000→+
 34001→+// initTracing sets up the trace provider and exporter.
 34002→+func initTracing(ctx context.Context, host string, insecure bool, res *resource.Resource) error {
 34003→+	exporterOpts := []otlptracegrpc.Option{
 34004→+		otlptracegrpc.WithEndpoint(host),
 34005→+	}
 34006→+	if insecure {
 34007→+		exporterOpts = append(exporterOpts, otlptracegrpc.WithInsecure())
 34008→+	}
 34009→+
 34010→+	exporter, err := otlptracegrpc.New(ctx, exporterOpts...)
 34011→+	if err != nil {
 34012→+		return fmt.Errorf("create OTLP trace exporter: %w", err)
 34013→+	}
 34014→+
 34015→+	traceProvider = sdktrace.NewTracerProvider(
 34016→+		sdktrace.WithBatcher(exporter),
 34017→+		sdktrace.WithResource(res),
 34018→+	)
 34019→+	otel.SetTracerProvider(traceProvider)
 34020→+
 34021→+	return nil
 34022→+}
 34023→+
 34024→+// initMetrics sets up the meter provider, exporter, and metric instruments.
 34025→+func initMetrics(ctx context.Context, host string, insecure bool, res *resource.Resource) error {
 34026→+	exporterOpts := []otlpmetricgrpc.Option{
 34027→+		otlpmetricgrpc.WithEndpoint(host),
 34028→+	}
 34029→+	if insecure {
 34030→+		exporterOpts = append(exporterOpts, otlpmetricgrpc.WithInsecure())
 34031→+	}
 34032→+
 34033→+	exporter, err := otlpmetricgrpc.New(ctx, exporterOpts...)
 34034→+	if err != nil {
 34035→+		return fmt.Errorf("create OTLP metric exporter: %w", err)
 34036→+	}
 34037→+
 34038→+	meterProvider = sdkmetric.NewMeterProvider(
 34039→+		sdkmetric.WithResource(res),
 34040→+		sdkmetric.WithReader(sdkmetric.NewPeriodicReader(exporter,
 34041→+			sdkmetric.WithInterval(metricExportInterval),
 34042→+		)),
 34043→+	)
 34044→+	otel.SetMeterProvider(meterProvider)
 34045→+
 34046→+	meter = meterProvider.Meter("specstory-cli")
 34047→+
 34048→+	// Initialize metric instruments
 34049→+	if err := initMetricInstruments(); err != nil {
 34050→+		return fmt.Errorf("create metric instruments: %w", err)
 34051→+	}
 34052→+
 34053→+	return nil
 34054→+}
 34055→+
 34056→+// initMetricInstruments creates all the metric instruments used by the CLI.
 34057→+func initMetricInstruments() error {
 34058→+	var err error
 34059→+
 34060→+	sessionsProcessed, err = meter.Int64Counter("specstory.sessions.processed",
 34061→+		metric.WithDescription("Number of sessions processed"),
 34062→+		metric.WithUnit("{session}"),
 34063→+	)
 34064→+	if err != nil {
 34065→+		return err
 34066→+	}
 34067→+
 34068→+	exchangesProcessed, err = meter.Int64Counter("specstory.exchanges.processed",
 34069→+		metric.WithDescription("Number of exchanges processed across all sessions"),
 34070→+		metric.WithUnit("{exchange}"),
 34071→+	)
 34072→+	if err != nil {
 34073→+		return err
 34074→+	}
 34075→+
 34076→+	messagesProcessed, err = meter.Int64Counter("specstory.messages.processed",
 34077→+		metric.WithDescription("Number of messages processed across all sessions"),
 34078→+		metric.WithUnit("{message}"),
 34079→+	)
 34080→+	if err != nil {

 34187→+// Shutdown flushes pending spans/metrics and shuts down both providers.
 34188→+// Safe to call even when Init was never called or telemetry is disabled.
 34189→+// For short-lived CLIs, this performs explicit ForceFlush calls before shutdown
 34190→+// to ensure all data is exported before the process exits.
 34191→+func Shutdown(ctx context.Context) error {
 34192→+	var errs []error
 34193→+
 34194→+	if traceProvider != nil {
 34195→+		telemetryLogger().Info("Flushing and shutting down trace provider")
 34196→+		// ForceFlush ensures all pending spans are exported before shutdown.
 34197→+		// This is critical for short-lived CLIs that may exit before the
 34198→+		// periodic exporter has time to run.
 34199→+		if err := traceProvider.ForceFlush(ctx); err != nil {
 34200→+			telemetryLogger().Warn("Failed to flush trace provider", "error", err)
 34201→+		}
 34202→+		if err := traceProvider.Shutdown(ctx); err != nil {
 34203→+			errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("shutdown trace provider: %w", err))
 34204→+		}
 34205→+	}
 34206→+
 34207→+	if meterProvider != nil {
 34208→+		telemetryLogger().Info("Flushing and shutting down meter provider")
 34209→+		// ForceFlush ensures all pending metrics are exported before shutdown.
 34210→+		// The periodic reader has a 10-second interval, so without this,
 34211→+		// metrics from short CLI runs would never be sent.
 34212→+		if err := meterProvider.ForceFlush(ctx); err != nil {
 34213→+			telemetryLogger().Warn("Failed to flush meter provider", "error", err)
 34214→+		}
 34215→+		if err := meterProvider.Shutdown(ctx); err != nil {
 34216→+			errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("shutdown meter provider: %w", err))
 34217→+		}
 34218→+	}
 34219→+
 34220→+	if len(errs) > 0 {
 34221→+		return errs[0] // Return first error
 34222→+	}
 34223→+	return nil
 34224→+}
 34225→+
 34226→+// ForceFlush explicitly flushes all pending spans and metrics.
 34227→+// Call this at the end of short-lived commands to ensure data is exported
 34228→+// before the command returns. Safe to call when telemetry is disabled.
 34229→+func ForceFlush(ctx context.Context) error {
 34230→+	var errs []error
 34231→+
 34232→+	if traceProvider != nil {
 34233→+		telemetryLogger().Debug("Force flushing trace provider")
 34234→+		if err := traceProvider.ForceFlush(ctx); err != nil {
 34235→+			telemetryLogger().Warn("Failed to force flush trace provider", "error", err)
 34236→+			errs = append(errs, err)
 34237→+		}
 34238→+	}
 34239→+
 34240→+	if meterProvider != nil {
 34241→+		telemetryLogger().Debug("Force flushing meter provider")
 34242→+		if err := meterProvider.ForceFlush(ctx); err != nil {
 34243→+			telemetryLogger().Warn("Failed to force flush meter provider", "error", err)
 34244→+			errs = append(errs, err)
 34245→+		}
 34246→+	}
 34247→+
 34248→+	if len(errs) > 0 {
 34249→+		return errs[0]
 34250→+	}
 34251→+	return nil
 34252→+}

 34269→+// ContextWithSessionTrace returns a context that will cause any spans started
 34270→+// from it to share the same trace ID (derived deterministically from sessionID).
 34271→+// This groups all spans for a given session into a single trace, even across
 34272→+// multiple invocations (e.g., in autosave mode where processSingleSession is
 34273→+// called repeatedly as the session file grows).
 34274→+func ContextWithSessionTrace(ctx context.Context, sessionID string) context.Context {
 34275→+	traceID := traceIDFromSessionID(sessionID)
 34276→+	spanID := spanIDFromSessionID(sessionID)
 34277→+
 34278→+	// Create a SpanContext with both deterministic trace ID and span ID.
 34279→+	// In OpenTelemetry-Go, a SpanContext is only valid if both TraceID and SpanID
 34280→+	// are valid. We mark it as Remote so child spans inherit the trace ID.
 34281→+	sc := trace.NewSpanContext(trace.SpanContextConfig{
 34282→+		TraceID:    traceID,
 34283→+		SpanID:     spanID,
 34284→+		TraceFlags: trace.FlagsSampled, // Ensure it's sampled
 34285→+		Remote:     true,               // Mark as remote parent
 34286→+	})
 34287→+
 34288→+	// Inject the SpanContext as a remote parent so child spans inherit the trace ID
 34289→+	return trace.ContextWithRemoteSpanContext(ctx, sc)
 34290→+}
 34291→+
 34292→+// traceIDFromSessionID generates a deterministic 16-byte trace ID from a session ID
 34293→+// by hashing the session ID with SHA-256 and taking the first 16 bytes.
 34294→+func traceIDFromSessionID(sessionID string) trace.TraceID {
 34295→+	hash := sha256.Sum256([]byte(sessionID))
 34296→+	var traceID trace.TraceID
 34297→+	copy(traceID[:], hash[:16])
 34298→+	return traceID
 34299→+}
 34300→+
 34301→+// spanIDFromSessionID generates a deterministic 8-byte span ID from a session ID
 34302→+// by hashing the session ID with SHA-256 and taking bytes 16-24.
 34303→+// This ensures the span ID is different from the trace ID but still deterministic.
 34304→+func spanIDFromSessionID(sessionID string) trace.SpanID {
 34305→+	hash := sha256.Sum256([]byte(sessionID))
 34306→+	var spanID trace.SpanID
 34307→+	copy(spanID[:], hash[16:24])
 34308→+	return spanID
 34309→+}

 34318→+	attrs = append(attrs, specific...)

   538→			sessionIDs, _ := cmd.Flags().GetStringSlice("session")
   539→
   540→			// Handle specific session sync if -s flag is provided
   541→			if len(sessionIDs) > 0 {
   542→				return syncSpecificSessions(cmd, args, sessionIDs)
   543→			}
   544→
   545→			slog.Info("Running sync command")
   546→			registry := factory.GetRegistry()
   547→
   548→			// Check if user specified a provider
   549→			if len(args) > 0 {
   550→				// Sync specific provider
   551→				return syncSingleProvider(registry, args[0], cmd)
   552→			} else {
   553→				// Sync all providers with activity
   554→				return syncAllProviders(registry, cmd)
   555→			}
   556→		},
   557→	}
   558→}
   559→
   560→// syncSpecificSessions syncs one or more sessions by their IDs
   561→// When printToStdout is set, outputs markdown to stdout instead of saving to files.
   562→// args[0] is the optional provider ID
   563→func syncSpecificSessions(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string, sessionIDs []string) error {
   564→	if len(sessionIDs) == 1 {
   565→		slog.Info("Running single session sync", "sessionId", sessionIDs[0])
   566→	} else {
   567→		slog.Info("Running multiple session sync", "sessionCount", len(sessionIDs))
   568→	}
   569→
   570→	// Get debug-raw flag value
   571→	debugRaw, _ := cmd.Flags().GetBool("debug-raw")
   572→	useUTC := !localTimeZone
   573→
   574→	cwd, err := os.Getwd()
   575→	if err != nil {
   576→		slog.Error("Failed to get current working directory", "error", err)
   577→		return err
   578→	}
   579→
   580→	// Setup file output and cloud sync (not needed for --print mode)
   581→	var config utils.OutputConfig
   582→	if !printToStdout {
   583→		config, err = utils.SetupOutputConfig(outputDir, debugDir)
   584→		if err != nil {
   585→			return err
   586→		}
   587→
   588→		identityManager := utils.NewProjectIdentityManager(cwd)
   589→		if _, err := identityManager.EnsureProjectIdentity(); err != nil {
   590→			slog.Error("Failed to ensure project identity", "error", err)
   591→		}
   592→
   593→		cmdpkg.CheckAndWarnAuthentication(noCloudSync)
   594→
   595→		if err := utils.EnsureHistoryDirectoryExists(config); err != nil {
   596→			return err
   597→		}
   598→	}
   599→
   600→	registry := factory.GetRegistry()
   601→
   602→	// Track statistics for summary output
   603→	var successCount, notFoundCount, errorCount int
   604→	var lastError error
   605→
   606→	// Resolve provider once if specified (fail fast if provider not found)
   607→	var specifiedProvider spi.Provider
   608→	if len(args) > 0 {
   609→		providerID := args[0]
   610→		provider, err := registry.Get(providerID)
   611→		if err != nil {
   612→			if !printToStdout {
   613→				fmt.Printf("❌ Provider '%s' not found\n", providerID)
   614→			}
   615→			return fmt.Errorf("provider '%s' not found: %w", providerID, err)
   616→		}
   617→		specifiedProvider = provider
   618→	}
   619→
   620→	// Process each session ID
   621→	var printedSessions int // tracks sessions printed to stdout for separator logic
   622→	for _, sessionID := range sessionIDs {
   623→		sessionID = strings.TrimSpace(sessionID)
   624→		if sessionID == "" {
   625→			continue // Skip empty session IDs
   626→		}
   627→
   628→		// Find session across providers
   629→		var session *spi.AgentChatSession
   630→
   631→		// Case A: Provider was specified - use it directly
   632→		if specifiedProvider != nil {
   633→			session, err = specifiedProvider.GetAgentChatSession(cwd, sessionID, debugRaw)
   634→			if err != nil {
   635→				if !printToStdout {
   636→					fmt.Printf("❌ Error getting session '%s' from %s: %v\n", sessionID, specifiedProvider.Name(), err)
   637→				}
   638→				slog.Error("Error getting session from provider", "sessionId", sessionID, "provider", specifiedProvider.Name(), "error", err)
   639→				errorCount++
   640→				lastError = err
   641→				continue
   642→			}
   643→			if session == nil {
   644→				if !printToStdout {
   645→					fmt.Printf("❌ Session '%s' not found in %s\n", sessionID, specifiedProvider.Name())
   646→				}
   647→				slog.Warn("Session not found in provider", "sessionId", sessionID, "provider", specifiedProvider.Name())
   648→				notFoundCount++
   649→				continue
   650→			}
   651→		} else {
   652→			// Case B: No provider specified - try all providers
   653→			providerIDs := registry.ListIDs()
   654→			for _, id := range providerIDs {
   655→				provider, err := registry.Get(id)
   656→				if err != nil {
   657→					continue
   658→				}
   659→
   660→				session, err = provider.GetAgentChatSession(cwd, sessionID, debugRaw)
   661→				if err != nil {
   662→					slog.Debug("Error checking provider for session", "provider", id, "sessionId", sessionID, "error", err)
   663→					continue
   664→				}
   665→				if session != nil {
   666→					if !silent && !printToStdout {
   667→						fmt.Printf("✅ Found session '%s' for %s\n", sessionID, provider.Name())
   668→					}
   669→					break // Found it, don't check other providers
   670→				}
   671→			}
   672→
   673→			if session == nil {
   674→				if !printToStdout {
   675→					fmt.Printf("❌ Session '%s' not found in any provider\n", sessionID)
   676→				}
   677→				slog.Warn("Session not found in any provider", "sessionId", sessionID)
   678→				notFoundCount++
   679→				continue
   680→			}
   681→		}
   682→
   683→		// Process the found session
   684→		if printToStdout {
   685→			sessionpkg.ValidateSessionData(session, debugRaw)
   686→			sessionpkg.WriteDebugSessionData(session, debugRaw)
   687→
   688→			markdownContent, err := sessionpkg.GenerateMarkdownFromAgentSession(session.SessionData, false, useUTC)
   689→			if err != nil {
   690→				slog.Error("Failed to generate markdown", "sessionId", session.SessionID, "error", err)
   691→				analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventSyncMarkdownError, analytics.Properties{
   692→					"session_id": session.SessionID,
   693→					"error":      err.Error(),
   694→					"mode":       "print",
   695→				})
   696→				errorCount++
   697→				lastError = err
   698→				continue
   699→			}
   700→
   701→			// Separate multiple sessions with a horizontal rule
   702→			if printedSessions > 0 {
   703→				fmt.Print("\n---\n\n")
   704→			}
   705→			fmt.Print(markdownContent)
   706→			printedSessions++
   707→			successCount++
   708→			analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventSyncMarkdownSuccess, analytics.Properties{
   709→				"session_id": session.SessionID,
   710→				"mode":       "print",
   711→			})
   712→		} else {
   713→			// Normal sync: write to file and optionally cloud sync
   714→			if _, err := sessionpkg.ProcessSingleSession(context.Background(), session, config, onlyCloudSync, true, false, debugRaw, useUTC, noTelemetryPrompts); err != nil {
   715→				errorCount++
   716→				lastError = err
   717→			} else {
   718→				successCount++
   719→			}
   720→		}
   721→	}
   722→
   723→	// Print summary if multiple sessions were processed (not for --print mode)
   724→	if !printToStdout && len(sessionIDs) > 1 && !silent {
   725→		fmt.Println()
   726→		fmt.Println("📊 Session sync summary:")
   727→		fmt.Printf("  ✅ %d %s successfully synced\n", successCount, pluralSession(successCount))
   728→		if notFoundCount > 0 {
   729→			fmt.Printf("  ❌ %d %s not found\n", notFoundCount, pluralSession(notFoundCount))
   730→		}
   731→		if errorCount > 0 {
   732→			fmt.Printf("  ❌ %d %s failed with errors\n", errorCount, pluralSession(errorCount))
   733→		}
   734→		fmt.Println()
   735→	}
   736→
   737→	// Return error if any sessions failed
   738→	if errorCount > 0 || (notFoundCount > 0 && successCount == 0) {
   739→		if lastError != nil {
   740→			return lastError
   741→		}
   742→		return fmt.Errorf("%d %s not found", notFoundCount, pluralSession(notFoundCount))
   743→	}
   744→
   745→	return nil
   746→}
   747→
   748→// preloadBulkSessionSizesIfNeeded optimizes bulk syncs by fetching all session sizes upfront.
   749→// This avoids making individual HEAD requests for each session during sync operations.
   750→//
   751→// The function only performs the preload if:
   752→//   - Cloud sync is enabled (noCloudSync flag is false)
   753→//   - User is authenticated with SpecStory Cloud
   754→//   - A valid projectID can be determined from the identity manager
   755→//
   756→// Parameters:
   757→//   - identityManager: Provides project identity (git_id or workspace_id) for the current project
   758→//
   759→// The preloaded sizes are cached in the SyncManager and shared across all providers since they
   760→// use the same projectID. If the bulk fetch fails or if projectID cannot be determined, individual
   761→// sessions will gracefully fall back to HEAD requests during sync.
   762→//
   763→// This function is safe to call multiple times but should typically be called once before processing
   764→// multiple sessions in batch sync operations.
   765→func preloadBulkSessionSizesIfNeeded(identityManager *utils.ProjectIdentityManager) {
   766→	// Skip if cloud sync is disabled or user is not authenticated
   767→	if noCloudSync || !cloud.IsAuthenticated() {
   768→		return
   769→	}
   770→
   771→	// Get projectID from identity manager - required for cloud sync
   772→	projectID, err := identityManager.GetProjectID()
   773→	if err != nil {
   774→		slog.Warn("Cannot preload session sizes: failed to get project ID", "error", err)
   775→		return
   776→	}
   777→
   778→	// Preload bulk sizes once - shared across all providers since they use same projectID
   779→	if syncMgr := cloud.GetSyncManager(); syncMgr != nil {
   780→		syncMgr.PreloadSessionSizes(projectID)
   781→	} else {
   782→		slog.Warn("Cannot preload session sizes: sync manager is nil despite authentication")
   783→	}
   784→}
   785→
   786→// syncProvider performs the actual sync for a single provider
   787→// Returns (sessionCount, error) for analytics tracking
   788→func syncProvider(provider spi.Provider, providerID string, config utils.OutputConfig, debugRaw bool, useUTC bool) (int, error) {
   789→	cwd, err := os.Getwd()
   790→	if err != nil {
   791→		slog.Error("Failed to get current working directory", "error", err)
   792→		return 0, err
   793→	}
   794→
   795→	// Create progress callback for parsing phase
   796→	// The callback updates the "Parsing..." line in place with [n/m] progress
   797→	var parseProgress spi.ProgressCallback
   798→	if !silent {
   799→		providerName := provider.Name()
   800→		parseProgress = func(current, total int) {
   801→			fmt.Printf("\rParsing %s sessions [%d/%d]", providerName, current, total)
   802→			_ = os.Stdout.Sync()
   803→		}
   804→	}
   805→
   806→	// Get all sessions from the provider
   807→	sessions, err := provider.GetAgentChatSessions(cwd, debugRaw, parseProgress)
   808→	if err != nil {
   809→		return 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to get sessions: %w", err)
   810→	}
   811→
   812→	sessionCount := len(sessions)
   813→
   814→	if sessionCount == 0 && !silent {
   815→		// This comes after "Parsing..." message, on the same line
   816→		fmt.Printf(", no non-empty sessions found for %s\n", provider.Name())
   817→		fmt.Println()
   818→		return 0, nil
   819→	}
   820→
   821→	if !silent {
   822→		fmt.Printf("\nSyncing markdown files for %s", provider.Name())
   823→	}
   824→
   825→	// Initialize statistics
   826→	stats := &SyncStats{
   827→		TotalSessions: sessionCount,
   828→	}
   829→
   830→	historyPath := config.GetHistoryDir()
   831→	agentName := provider.Name()
   832→	ctx := context.Background()
   833→
   834→	// Process each session
   835→	for i := range sessions {
   836→		session := &sessions[i]
   837→
   838→		// Process session in a closure so defers scope to each iteration,
   839→		// ensuring spans are ended and metrics recorded even on early returns.
   840→		func() {
   841→			processingStart := time.Now()
   842→
   843→			// Create a context with a deterministic trace ID from the session ID
   844→			sessionCtx := telemetry.ContextWithSessionTrace(ctx, session.SessionID)
   845→
   846→			// Start an OTel span for this session processing
   847→			sessionCtx, span := telemetry.Tracer("specstory").Start(sessionCtx, "process_session")
   848→			defer span.End()
   849→
   850→			// Compute session statistics
   851→			sessionStats := telemetry.ComputeSessionStats(agentName, session)
   852→			defer func() {
   853→				telemetry.RecordSessionMetrics(sessionCtx, sessionStats, time.Since(processingStart))
   854→			}()
   855→
   856→			// Set session span attributes
   857→			telemetry.SetSessionSpanAttributes(span, sessionStats)
   858→
   859→			// Create child spans for each exchange
   860→			if session.SessionData != nil && len(session.SessionData.Exchanges) > 0 {
   861→				telemetry.ProcessExchangeSpans(sessionCtx, sessionStats, session.SessionData.Exchanges, noTelemetryPrompts)
   862→			}
   863→
   864→			sessionpkg.ValidateSessionData(session, debugRaw)
   865→			sessionpkg.WriteDebugSessionData(session, debugRaw)
   866→
   867→			// Generate markdown from SessionData
   868→			markdownContent, err := sessionpkg.GenerateMarkdownFromAgentSession(session.SessionData, false, useUTC)
   869→			if err != nil {
   870→				slog.Error("Failed to generate markdown from SessionData",
   871→					"sessionId", session.SessionID,
   872→					"error", err)
   873→				// Track sync error
   874→				analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventSyncMarkdownError, analytics.Properties{
   875→					"session_id": session.SessionID,
   876→					"error":      err.Error(),
   877→				})
   878→				return
   879→			}
   880→
   881→			// Generate filename from timestamp and slug
   882→			fileFullPath := sessionpkg.BuildSessionFilePath(session, historyPath, useUTC)
   883→
   884→			// Check if file already exists with same content
   885→			identicalContent := false
   886→			fileExists := false
   887→			if existingContent, err := os.ReadFile(fileFullPath); err == nil {
   888→				fileExists = true
   889→				if string(existingContent) == markdownContent {
   890→					identicalContent = true
   891→					slog.Info("Markdown file already exists with same content, skipping write",
   892→						"sessionId", session.SessionID,
   893→						"path", fileFullPath)
   894→				}
   895→			}
   896→
   897→			// Write file if needed (skip if only-cloud-sync is enabled)
   898→			if !onlyCloudSync {
   899→				if !identicalContent {
   900→					// Ensure history directory exists (handles deletion during long-running sync)
   901→					if err := utils.EnsureHistoryDirectoryExists(config); err != nil {
   902→						slog.Error("Failed to ensure history directory", "error", err)
   903→						return
   904→					}
   905→					err := os.WriteFile(fileFullPath, []byte(markdownContent), 0644)
   906→					if err != nil {
   907→						slog.Error("Error writing markdown file",
   908→							"sessionId", session.SessionID,
   909→							"error", err)
   910→						// Track sync error
   911→						analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventSyncMarkdownError, analytics.Properties{
   912→							"session_id":      session.SessionID,
   913→							"error":           err.Error(),
   914→							"only_cloud_sync": onlyCloudSync,
   915→						})
   916→						return
   917→					}
   918→					slog.Info("Successfully wrote file",
   919→						"sessionId", session.SessionID,
   920→						"path", fileFullPath)
   921→
   922→					// Track successful sync
   923→					if !fileExists {
   924→						analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventSyncMarkdownNew, analytics.Properties{
   925→							"session_id":      session.SessionID,
   926→							"only_cloud_sync": onlyCloudSync,
   927→						})
   928→					} else {
   929→						analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventSyncMarkdownSuccess, analytics.Properties{
   930→							"session_id":      session.SessionID,
   931→							"only_cloud_sync": onlyCloudSync,
   932→						})
   933→					}
   934→				}
   935→
   936→				// Update statistics for normal mode
   937→				if identicalContent {
   938→					stats.SessionsSkipped++
   939→				} else if fileExists {
   940→					stats.SessionsUpdated++
   941→				} else {
   942→					stats.SessionsCreated++
   943→				}
   944→			} else {
   945→				// In cloud-only mode, count as skipped since no local file operation occurred
   946→				stats.SessionsSkipped++
   947→				slog.Info("Skipping local file write (only-cloud-sync mode)",
   948→					"sessionId", session.SessionID)
   949→			}
   950→
   951→			// Trigger cloud sync with provider-specific data
   952→			// Manual sync command: perform immediate sync with HEAD check (not autosave mode)
   953→			// In only-cloud-sync mode: always sync
   954→			cloud.SyncSessionToCloud(session.SessionID, fileFullPath, markdownContent, []byte(session.RawData), provider.Name(), false)
   955→		}()
   956→
   957→		// Print progress with [n/m] format
   958→		if !silent {
   959→			fmt.Printf("\rSyncing markdown files for %s [%d/%d]", provider.Name(), i+1, sessionCount)
   960→			_ = os.Stdout.Sync()
   961→		}
   962→	}
   963→
   964→	// Print newline after progress
   965→	if !silent && sessionCount > 0 && !onlyCloudSync {
   966→		fmt.Println()
   967→
   968→		// Calculate actual total of processed sessions
   969→		actualTotal := stats.SessionsSkipped + stats.SessionsUpdated + stats.SessionsCreated
   970→
   971→		// Print summary message with proper pluralization
   972→		fmt.Printf("\n%s✅ %s sync complete!%s 📊 %s%d%s %s processed\n",
   973→			log.ColorBoldGreen, provider.Name(), log.ColorReset,
   974→			log.ColorBoldCyan, actualTotal, log.ColorReset, pluralSession(actualTotal))
   975→		fmt.Println()
   976→
   977→		fmt.Printf("  ⏭️ %s%d %s up to date (skipped)%s\n",
   978→			log.ColorCyan, stats.SessionsSkipped, pluralSession(stats.SessionsSkipped), log.ColorReset)
   979→		fmt.Printf("  ♻️ %s%d %s updated%s\n",
   980→			log.ColorYellow, stats.SessionsUpdated, pluralSession(stats.SessionsUpdated), log.ColorReset)
   981→		fmt.Printf("  ✨ %s%d new %s created%s\n",
   982→			log.ColorGreen, stats.SessionsCreated, pluralSession(stats.SessionsCreated), log.ColorReset)
   983→		fmt.Println()
   984→	}
   985→
   986→	return sessionCount, nil
   987→}

   989→// syncAllProviders syncs all providers that have activity in the current directory
   990→func syncAllProviders(registry *factory.Registry, cmd *cobra.Command) error {
   991→	// Get debug-raw flag value
   992→	debugRaw, _ := cmd.Flags().GetBool("debug-raw")
   993→	useUTC := !localTimeZone
   994→
   995→	cwd, err := os.Getwd()
   996→	if err != nil {
   997→		slog.Error("Failed to get current working directory", "error", err)
   998→		return err
   999→	}
  1000→
  1001→	providerIDs := registry.ListIDs()
  1002→	providersWithActivity := []string{}
  1003→
  1004→	// Check each provider for activity
  1005→	for _, id := range providerIDs {
  1006→		provider, err := registry.Get(id)
  1007→		if err != nil {
  1008→			slog.Warn("Failed to get provider", "id", id, "error", err)
  1009→			continue
  1010→		}
  1011→
  1012→		if provider.DetectAgent(cwd, false) {
  1013→			providersWithActivity = append(providersWithActivity, id)
  1014→		}
  1015→	}
  1016→
  1017→	// If no providers have activity, show helpful message
  1018→	if len(providersWithActivity) == 0 {
  1019→		if !silent {
  1020→			fmt.Println() // Add visual separation
  1021→			log.UserWarn("No coding agent activity found for this project directory.\n\n")
  1022→
  1023→			log.UserMessage("We checked for activity in '%s' from the following agents:\n", cwd)
  1024→			for _, id := range providerIDs {
  1025→				if provider, err := registry.Get(id); err == nil {
  1026→					log.UserMessage("- %s\n", provider.Name())
  1027→				}
  1028→			}
  1029→			log.UserMessage("\nBut didn't find any activity.\n\n")
  1030→
  1031→			log.UserMessage("To fix this:\n")
  1032→			log.UserMessage("  1. Run 'specstory run' to start the default agent in this directory\n")
  1033→			log.UserMessage("  2. Run 'specstory run <agent>' to start a specific agent in this directory\n")
  1034→			log.UserMessage("  3. Or run the agent directly first, then try syncing again\n")
  1035→			fmt.Println() // Add trailing newline
  1036→		}
  1037→		return nil
  1038→	}
  1039→
  1040→	// Collect provider names for analytics
  1041→	var providerNames []string
  1042→	for _, id := range providersWithActivity {
  1043→		if provider, err := registry.Get(id); err == nil {
  1044→			providerNames = append(providerNames, provider.Name())
  1045→		}
  1046→	}
  1047→	analytics.SetAgentProviders(providerNames)
  1048→
  1049→	// Setup output configuration (once for all providers)
  1050→	config, err := utils.SetupOutputConfig(outputDir, debugDir)
  1051→	if err != nil {
  1052→		return err
  1053→	}
  1054→
  1055→	// Initialize project identity (once for all providers)
  1056→	identityManager := utils.NewProjectIdentityManager(cwd)
  1057→	if _, err := identityManager.EnsureProjectIdentity(); err != nil {
  1058→		slog.Error("Failed to ensure project identity", "error", err)
  1059→	}
  1060→
  1061→	// Check authentication for cloud sync (once)
  1062→	cmdpkg.CheckAndWarnAuthentication(noCloudSync)
  1063→
  1064→	// Ensure history directory exists (once)
  1065→	if err := utils.EnsureHistoryDirectoryExists(config); err != nil {
  1066→		return err
  1067→	}
  1068→
  1069→	// Preload session sizes for batch sync optimization (ONCE for all providers)
  1070→	preloadBulkSessionSizesIfNeeded(identityManager)
  1071→
  1072→	// Sync each provider with activity
  1073→	totalSessionCount := 0
  1074→	var lastError error
  1075→
  1076→	for _, id := range providersWithActivity {
  1077→		provider, err := registry.Get(id)
  1078→		if err != nil {
  1079→			continue
  1080→		}
  1081→
  1082→		if !silent {
  1083→			fmt.Printf("\nParsing %s sessions", provider.Name())
  1084→		}
  1085→
  1086→		sessionCount, err := syncProvider(provider, id, config, debugRaw, useUTC)
  1087→		totalSessionCount += sessionCount
  1088→
  1089→		if err != nil {
  1090→			lastError = err
  1091→			slog.Error("Error syncing provider", "provider", id, "error", err)
  1092→		}
  1093→	}
  1094→
  1095→	// Track overall analytics
  1096→	if lastError != nil {
  1097→		analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventSyncMarkdownError, analytics.Properties{
  1098→			"provider":      "all",
  1099→			"error":         lastError.Error(),
  1100→			"session_count": totalSessionCount,
  1101→		})
  1102→		// Brief delay to ensure error event is sent before exit
  1103→		// TODO: This is a workaround for async analytics - should be fixed properly
  1104→		time.Sleep(500 * time.Millisecond)
  1105→	} else {
  1106→		analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventSyncMarkdownSuccess, analytics.Properties{
  1107→			"provider":      "all",
  1108→			"session_count": totalSessionCount,
  1109→		})
  1110→	}
  1111→
  1112→	return lastError
  1113→}
  1114→
  1115→// syncSingleProvider syncs a specific provider
  1116→func syncSingleProvider(registry *factory.Registry, providerID string, cmd *cobra.Command) error {
  1117→	// Get debug-raw flag value
  1118→	debugRaw, _ := cmd.Flags().GetBool("debug-raw")
  1119→	useUTC := !localTimeZone
  1120→
  1121→	provider, err := registry.Get(providerID)
  1122→	if err != nil {
  1123→		// Provider not found - show helpful error
  1124→		fmt.Printf("❌ Provider '%s' is not a valid provider implementation\n\n", providerID)
  1125→
  1126→		ids := registry.ListIDs()
  1127→		if len(ids) > 0 {
  1128→			fmt.Println("The registered providers are:")
  1129→			for _, id := range ids {
  1130→				if p, _ := registry.Get(id); p != nil {
  1131→					fmt.Printf("  • %s - %s\n", id, p.Name())
  1132→				}
  1133→			}
  1134→			fmt.Println("\nExample: specstory sync " + ids[0])
  1135→		}
  1136→		return err
  1137→	}
  1138→
  1139→	// Set the agent provider for analytics
  1140→	analytics.SetAgentProviders([]string{provider.Name()})
  1141→
  1142→	cwd, err := os.Getwd()
  1143→	if err != nil {
  1144→		slog.Error("Failed to get current working directory", "error", err)
  1145→		return err
  1146→	}
  1147→
  1148→	// Check if provider has activity, with helpful output if not
  1149→	if !provider.DetectAgent(cwd, true) {
  1150→		// Provider already output helpful message
  1151→		return nil
  1152→	}
  1153→
  1154→	// Setup output configuration
  1155→	config, err := utils.SetupOutputConfig(outputDir, debugDir)
  1156→	if err != nil {
  1157→		return err
  1158→	}
  1159→
  1160→	// Initialize project identity
  1161→	identityManager := utils.NewProjectIdentityManager(cwd)
  1162→	if _, err := identityManager.EnsureProjectIdentity(); err != nil {
  1163→		slog.Error("Failed to ensure project identity", "error", err)
  1164→	}
  1165→
  1166→	// Check authentication for cloud sync
  1167→	cmdpkg.CheckAndWarnAuthentication(noCloudSync)
  1168→
  1169→	// Ensure history directory exists
  1170→	if err := utils.EnsureHistoryDirectoryExists(config); err != nil {
  1171→		return err
  1172→	}
  1173→
  1174→	// Preload session sizes for batch sync optimization
  1175→	preloadBulkSessionSizesIfNeeded(identityManager)
  1176→
  1177→	if !silent {
  1178→		fmt.Printf("\nParsing %s sessions", provider.Name())
  1179→	}
  1180→
  1181→	// Perform the sync
  1182→	sessionCount, syncErr := syncProvider(provider, providerID, config, debugRaw, useUTC)
  1183→
  1184→	// Track analytics
  1185→	if syncErr != nil {
  1186→		analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventSyncMarkdownError, analytics.Properties{
  1187→			"provider":      providerID,
  1188→			"error":         syncErr.Error(),
  1189→			"session_count": sessionCount,
  1190→		})
  1191→		// Brief delay to ensure error event is sent before exit
  1192→		// TODO: This is a workaround for async analytics - should be fixed properly
  1193→		time.Sleep(500 * time.Millisecond)
  1194→	} else {
  1195→		analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventSyncMarkdownSuccess, analytics.Properties{
  1196→			"provider":      providerID,
  1197→			"session_count": sessionCount,
  1198→		})
  1199→	}
  1200→
  1201→	return syncErr
  1202→}

  1204→var syncCmd *cobra.Command
